description: UI: the reaction sheet's 6th tile (🙏) becomes a '+' tile (aria-label 'Więcej emoji') that switches the same #reactionSheet dialog into a full-emoji mode: back button, category tabs (9), scrollable grid of the active category, roving-tabindex keyboard nav, 44px targets, same toggle()+closeSheet() path as quick reactions. Adds public/emoji-picker.js, CSS section in chat-reactions.css, markup in wiadomosci.html, asset ?v= bumps, sw.js precache entries and CACHE_NAME v133, docs, and the UI half of tests/e2e/chat-emoji-picker.spec.js. DEPENDS on FEAT-001 (dataset, isAllowedReactionEmoji, CHAT_QUICK_REACTIONS, escAttr). Read the plan file section 'FEAT-002' for the exact CSS values and the full test list.
steps: Create public/emoji-picker.js: EmojiPicker.create(container, { onSelect, isSelected }) -> { show, refreshSelected, focusFirst, reset }. Tab row role=tablist (aria-label 'Kategorie emoji', class emoji-picker-tabs), tabs role=tab with Polish aria-label, aria-selected, roving tabindex, Left/Right/Home/End. Grid role=tabpanel aria-labelledby=active tab, one native <button class='emoji-picker-btn' data-emoji> per emoji of the ACTIVE category only, built with createElement/textContent/setAttribute (no innerHTML), glyph NOT aria-hidden, aria-pressed from isSelected, roving tabindex with Arrow/Home/End (columns derived from offsetTop). Last category kept in memory; reset() returns to first category + scrollTop 0.

public/chat-reactions.js UI: paintSheet() paints CHAT_QUICK_REACTIONS + a '+' tile (), guard on the new tile count; fall back to a 🙏 tile when window.EmojiData or window.EmojiPicker is missing. Add showAll()/showQuick() toggling #reactionSheet.is-all, hidden attributes on #reactionSheetGrid / #emojiPickerRoot / #reactionSheetBack, the title text ('Wybierz reakcję' / 'Wszystkie emoji'); showAll() lazily creates the picker and focuses its first emoji; showQuick() focuses the '+' tile. openSheet() always starts quick; closeSheet() resets to quick. Grid click handler: .reaction-sheet-more -> showAll(); else unchanged toggle()+closeSheet(). Picker onSelect = toggle(sheetMessageId, emoji); closeSheet(). paintSheet() also calls picker.refreshSelected() in full mode (only flips aria-pressed). focusables() = button:not([disabled]):not([tabindex='-1']) excluding anything inside [hidden]. Back button click -> showQuick(). Escape / overlay tap still close the whole sheet.

Do not change any existing rule's values. Do not touch home-page.css.

Extend tests/e2e/chat-emoji-picker.spec.js with the UI tests listed in the plan (quick view has 5 tiles + '+' and no 🙏; + opens full mode with 9 tabs and focus in the grid; pick 🎉 -> chip aria-pressed, sheet closed, focus on add button, repick toggles off with added/removed responses; 🙏 reachable via People tab; Escape/overlay/back behaviours; arrow-key nav + single tab stop + Tab trap; 44px targets at 375; sheet inside viewport and no overflow at 320/375/768/1024 excluding .emoji-picker-tabs; reduced-motion transition 0s; contrast checks; XSS via page.route'd thread payload renders no chip and window.__xss undefined; sw.js and wiadomosci.html contain the four versioned URLs and prezenty-v133). Restore demo state after each test.
acceptance_criteria: The reaction sheet's quick grid shows ❤️ 😂 👍 🎁 😮 and a '+' tile with aria-label 'Więcej emoji'; there is no 🙏 tile in #reactionSheetGrid

Tapping '+' shows the full picker in the same dialog (9 category tabs, scrollable grid); choosing an emoji sends the same POST, optimistically adds/removes the chip, and closes the sheet with focus back on the message's add button; choosing one already reacted removes it
🙏 can still be chosen via the full picker (People tab)
Escape and outside tap close the sheet from both modes; the back button returns to quick mode focusing '+'; Tab never leaves the dialog; the grid has exactly one tab stop
At 320/375/768/1024 the open picker lies fully inside the viewport and the page has no horizontal overflow (the tab row is the only inner horizontal scroller)
All tabs and emoji buttons are >= 44x44 CSS px; focus ring and pressed cue are visible; prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions
Hostile emoji strings in a server payload render nothing and execute nothing

DESIGN NOTES: picker remembers the last category in memory (reset() exists but closeSheet does not call it); closeSheet() calls showQuick() synchronously because the sheet is already visibility:hidden then, so the swap is never visible. NOT VERIFIABLE HERE: real phone / on-screen keyboard, screen-reader pass, Edge only (no Firefox/Safari), glyph support for Emoji 15.0 depends on the user's OS font, real MySQL two-account smoke test (demo mode executes no SQL), sw.js precache behaviour is only checked by string assertions (no real service-worker install/offline run).
